note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a SAU 9; A06b SAU 9; L05 SAU 13(a)): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Saudi Arabia, 2024
sources.said: Person has had a permanent resident permit (iqama) inside the Kingdom for 5 years continuously as a minimum. Note that under article 20 of the citizenship law it states that residency period will be reset if the applicant after filing his application left the kingdom for more than 12 months using his existing passport, or if before filing his application they left the kingdom for more than 6 months. ... Proof that person will renounce his/her original citizenship required. ... Person obtains another citizenship without permission by the Prime Minister. Person is given a 3 month warning before citizenship is withdrawn.
